anomalies.observed: The LD39200 3.3V LDO output (REG3.OUT, pin 1) sits on net +3.3V together with all the I2C sensor ICs. The MCU decoupling capacitors and the reset/boot pull-ups sit on a *different* net, +3V3, which has no regulator or other source, and the MCUs' supply pins are on no net at all: unconnected-(FCC2-VDD-Pad11/27/50/75/100) and unconnected-(NAVC2-VDD-Pad19/32/48/64) are all 'power_in' pins with a single node each.
anomalies.expected: The specification states one 3V3 rail: '3.3 V LDO (MCUs + sensors) ... LD39200PU33R' and '3V3 feeds both MCUs (FCC, NAVC) and all I2C sensor ICs'. The LDO output must be the same net that powers the MCU VDD pins and the sensor VDD pins.

evidence.quote: 3.3 V LDO (MCUs + sensors) | Hades (top sheet) | ST LD39200PU33R
3V3 feeds both MCUs (FCC, NAVC) and all I2C sensor ICs

anomalies.impact: Both MCUs receive no 3.3V supply; the board cannot boot. The +3V3 net (MCU decoupling/pull-ups) is left floating and the sensor rail is isolated from the MCUs.

anomalies.observed: The NAVC sensor I2C bus (SCL = NET0090, SDA = NET0171) contains R71/R92, TP2/TP4 and the BMI088 (U2.8/U2.9), IIS2MDCTR (U10.1/U10.4), TMP100 (U12.1/U12.6), MPRLS barometer (U19.2/U19.3) and 24CW1280 EEPROM (U4.1/U4.3) — but no NAVC2 pin. Likewise the NAVC HSE crystal HSE1 (pins 1/3) and the UART4_NAVC2/GPS_NAVC2 connector signals terminate on nets with no NAVC2 node, and almost every NAVC2 GPIO is listed as 'unconnected-(NAVC2-...)'.
anomalies.expected: The NAVC (STM32F405) is the sensor hub and must be connected to the IMU, magnetometer, barometer, temperature sensor, EEPROM, GPS and the FCC link (UART2 + I2C + GPIO).

evidence.quote: Navigation Computer (NAVC) — gathers IMU, magnetometer, pressure sensor and GPS receiver data, backed by its own EEPROM

anomalies.impact: The navigation computer cannot read any of its sensors or communicate with the FCC, so the autopilot has no state estimate.

anomalies.observed: The STM32H753 internal-regulator VCAP pins are routed to the UART3 connector instead of to their decoupling capacitors: NET0022 joins FCC2.VCAP (pin 48) to UART3_FCC2.3 and NET0140 joins FCC2.VCAP (pin 73) to UART3_FCC2.4. The 2.2uF capacitor C11 intended for this purpose has its positive terminal floating (unconnected-(C11-Pad1), pin 1 on no net).
anomalies.expected: STM32H7 VCAP pins are internal 1.2V regulator outputs and each must be decoupled to GND with a 2.2uF capacitor; they must not be brought out to a UART connector. UART3_FCC2 should carry the FCC UART3 TX/RX signals.
